exposure: fetal inflammatory reaction in the placenta
outcome: inflammatory mediator production (G-CSF, IFN-gamma, IL-1beta, IL-6, IL-8, IL-10, and TNF-alpha)
cohort: 44 late preterm and full-term babies born by Caesarean section.
finding: Fetuses with evidence of chorioamnionitis and fetal inflammatory reaction in their placentae had significantly increased immune responses to cGAMP and 5'ppp-dsRNA and significantly decreased immune responses to poly (I:C).
